# Rapider Personal Task & To-Do Management

**Suite:** Rapider Personal Suite

### 1.1 Consumer & Knowledge-Worker Problem Solved
Individuals juggle household errands, bills, appointments, learning goals, side projects, and work assignments across sticky notes, chat self-DMs, and rigid corporate project trackers—leading either to dropped commitments or overwhelming, guilt-inducing overdue backlogs. Worse, putting personal errands inside corporate project tools (`apm`) exposes private life details to employers and managers. **Rapider Personal Task & To-Do Management (`personal-task-and-to-do-management`)** provides a **strictly owner-isolated (`ownerUserRef == authenticatedActor`)** GTD and daily time-blocking sanctuary that pairs instant natural-language capture with realistic daily capacity planning, Pomodoro focus execution, and non-punitive habit tracking.

### 1.2 Fast-Path Everyday Flow vs. Power-User GTD Depth
- **Fast-Path Everyday Defaults (Zero-Config Users, Students, Families):** Open straight into **My Day** and **Inbox**, type `"Call dentist tomorrow 10am p1"` in Quick Add, check off items in one click, and share a single *Groceries* list with a partner—no folders, tags, or rituals required.
- **Progressive Power-User Depth (GTD Practitioners, Freelancers, Busy Executives):** Unlock **Areas of Responsibility**, *When Date* vs. *Hard Deadline* separation (*Today* / *This Evening* / *Someday*), `<rapider-kanban>` boards, 4-quadrant **Eisenhower Matrix**, 15-minute visual time-blocking with read-only `ApmIssue` work-task pull, Pomodoro timers, guided morning/shutdown rituals, and consent-scoped AI task breakdown.

### 1.3 Measurable Outcomes
- **Sub-4-Second Task Capture:** Deterministic inline NLP parses dates, recurrence, durations, `#list`, `@label`, and `p1`–`p4` without opening modal pickers.
- **>= 35% Reduction in Chronic Overdue Rollover:** Separating *When* (`scheduledDate`) from *Hard Deadline* (`deadlineDate`) plus a daily capacity bar (e.g., `5.5h / 6.0h`) curates realistic daily slates.
- **100% Personal Privacy Guarantee:** Server-enforced owner isolation guarantees `0` unauthorized reads of personal tasks, habits, or reflections by workspace or employer administrators.

### Industry Benchmark Alignment
Architected and benchmarked against leading global enterprise platforms in this category to unify rapid SME onboarding with enterprise-grade governance, compliance, and cross-suite automation on Rapider.

Core End-to-End User Journeys ### 5.1 Natural-Language Capture, Completion-Relative Recurrence & Click-Through Detail (`inbox-tasks` -> `task-detail` -> `inbox-tasks`) 1. On `#/inbox-tasks`, the user types `"Replace HVAC filter every! 90 days tomorrow 6pm for 20m #Home @maintenance p2"` into the Quick Add bar. 2. Live token chips preview `scheduledDate = Tomorrow`, `dayBucket = THIS_EVENING`, `plannedMinutes = 20`, `recurrenceMode = AFTER_COMPLETION (90d)`, `list = Home`, `labels = [@maintenance]`, `priority = P2_HIGH`. Pressing **Add** optimistically inserts the row and clears SWR cache. 3. Filtering by `@maintenance` displays `#activeFilterTagsBar` (`Label: "@maintenance" ✕ [Clear all]`). The user clicks the task title link, smoothly navigating to `#/task-detail?id=...` (verified free of `` path hijacking), adds two checklist steps (*Check size 16x25x1*, *Vacuum intake vent*), and clicks **Back to list**, restoring `#/inbox-tasks` with the `@maintenance` filter intact. 4. Checking off the task three days later calculates the next occurrence `90 days` from the actual completion date (not the original scheduled date) and records the finished instance in `logbook-insights`. ### 5.2 Mindful Morning Ritual, One-Way Work Bridge & Realistic Time-Blocking (`my-day` -> `upcoming-calendar`) 1. At `08:30`, the user opens `#/my-day` and clicks **Start Morning Plan**. The ritual drawer shows `3.5h` of meetings from Platform Calendar, `2` personal deadline items, and `1` assigned `ApmIssue` (`"Review Q4 API spec"`, read-only from `apm`) in the *Assigned at Work* tray. 2. The user drags `"Review Q4 API spec"` (`90m`) and three personal tasks (`"Pay utility bill" 15m`, `"Prep tax folder" 45m`, `"Grocery pickup" 30m` in *This Evening*) onto `#/upcoming-calendar`. 3. `PrsTaskDailyRitual` updates `plannedTotalHours = 3.00` against `dailyCapacityHours = 3.50` (`Decimal128`). Meanwhile, a manager viewing `apm` sees **zero** trace of `"Pay utility bill"` or `"Prep tax folder"`. ### 5.3 Pomodoro Focus Execution & Pause-Aware Effort Tracking (`focus-timer` -> `logbook-insights`) 1. From `#/my-day`, the user clicks **Focus** on `"Prep tax folder"`, opening `#/focus-timer` with a `25:00` Pomodoro timer. 2. Midway, the user pauses for `4m 10s` to answer the door, resumes, finishes the interval, ticks off subtasks, and marks the task `DONE`. 3. `PrsTaskFocusSession` persists `actualFocusSeconds = 1500` and `pausedTotalSeconds = 250` (`pausedTotalSeconds` strictly excluded from focused totals), immediately updating `#/logbook-insights`. ### 5.4 Household Shared List Invite & Instant Revocation (`areas-and-lists` -> `share-list-drawer` -> Home `WorkItem`) 1. On `#/areas-and-lists`, the user opens the *Family Groceries* list (`#/list-detail?id=...`) and clicks **Share List**, opening `share-list-drawer`. 2. Entering their partner's account (with optional E.164 lookup via ``) and `EDITOR` role creates a `PENDING` `PrsTaskShareGrant`, dispatches a Rapider Home `WorkItem` to the partner, and auto-closes the drawer via `closePageDrawer()`. 3. Once accepted, the partner can add/check off items in *Family Groceries* only—attempts to query the owner's `Inbox`, `PrsTaskHabit`, or `PrsTaskDailyRitual` return `403 Forbidden`. Revoking the grant on `#/privacy-sharing` immediately cuts off access to *Family Groceries* as well. ### 5.5 Consent-Scoped AI Brain-Dump ("Ramble") & Task Breakdown (`new-task-drawer` / `task-detail`) 1. Opening `new-task-drawer` in **Brain-Dump Mode**, the user pastes a messy paragraph: *"Need to renew passport before June 15, book passport photo this Saturday morning, and mail old passport next Tuesday"*. 2. The grounded AI extractor populates a 3-row editable staging table (`Renew passport` w/ `deadlineDate = June 15`; `Book passport photo` w/ `scheduledDate = Saturday MORNING`; `Mail old passport` w/ `scheduledDate = Tuesday`). Nothing is written to the database until the user reviews, edits a duration, and clicks **Create 3 Tasks**. --- ## 6. **WP-P0-2 — My Day Slate, Kanban, Eisenhower Matrix & Time-Blocking (`PTD-008`–`PTD-010`, `PTD-014`):** Deliver auto-resetting `my-day`, `` board, 4-quadrant `priority-matrix`, and 15/30-minute `upcoming-calendar` time-blocking with `Decimal128` capacity bar. - **WP-P0-3 — Pomodoro Focus Timer & Data Portability (`PTD-015`, `PTD-020`):** Deliver pause-aware `PrsTaskFocusSession` on `focus-timer`, natural-language personal task capture/Pomodoro & habit calendar CSV/JSON import, full JSON/CSV/ICS export, and cascade personal data erasure on `privacy-sharing`. ### `P1` Consumer Power & Household Scale Work Packages - **WP-P1-2 — Daily Habits, Logbook Insights & Household List Sharing (`PTD-016`, `PTD-017`, `PTD-019`, `PTD-021`):** Build `PrsTaskHabit` + `PrsTaskHabitCheckIn` (`null` vs. `SKIPPED` honesty), `logbook-insights`, `PrsTaskShareGrant` household collaboration via Home `WorkItem`s (`share-list-drawer`), and revocable masked ICS feed tokens. ### `P2` Adjacent & Grounded AI Work Packages - **WP-P2-1 — Consent-Scoped AI Breakdown, Ramble Extraction & Cross-Personal Links (`PTD-022`–`PTD-026`):** Deliver review-before-apply AI subtask breakdown, text/voice/screenshot brain-dump task extraction, overcommitment deferral coaching in private `projectChannelMessage` threads, NL-to-`#activeFilterTagsBar` chip translation, and intra-owner `PER` deep links (`#178`, `#180`, `#182`). --- ## 7. Roles, Permissions & Field-Level Governance | Role | Permitted Actions | Restricted / Field-Level Boundaries | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Personal Owner** | Full CRUD on own `PrsTask*` records, Inbox, Life Areas, Habits, Focus Sessions, Daily Rituals, AI prompts, imports/exports, masked ICS tokens, and `PrsTaskShareGrant` issuance/revocation. | Read-only on linked work `ApmIssue`s within `#177` (must open `apm` to mutate work issue status if governed by project workflows). | | **Shared List Collaborator (`EDITOR`)** | Read, create, check off, edit, and comment (`projectChannelMessage`) on `PrsTaskItem`s and `PrsTaskSection`s strictly inside the single explicitly granted `PrsTaskList` while `grantStatus == ACTIVE`. | **Zero access (`403`)** to the owner's `Inbox`, other `PrsTaskList`s, `PrsTaskDailyRitual` reflections, `PrsTaskHabit`s, `PrsTaskFocusSession`s, or `linkedWorkEntityRef` details; cannot delete the shared list or re-share it. | | **Shared List Collaborator (`VIEWER`)** | Read-only view of `PrsTaskItem`s inside the single granted `PrsTaskList` while `grantStatus == ACTIVE`. | Cannot create, edit, check off, reorder, or delete tasks; zero access to any other owner records. | | **Workspace / Employer Administrator** | Enable/disable the microapplication in workspace catalog and monitor aggregate anonymous service health (error rate, queue latency). | **STRICTLY BLOCKED (`403 Forbidden`)** from reading, listing, searching, auditing, or exporting any user's `PrsTask*` tasks, titles, notes, habits, focus sessions, or ritual reflections (`PTD-001`). | --- ## 8. Technical APIs, Guarded Commands, Events & `requiredWorkflows` ### 8.1 Guarded Domain Commands All commands resolve `ownerUserRef` from authenticated JWT claims (never from client payloads) and require `idempotencyKey`, `correlationId`, and `expectedVersion`: - `per.task.quickCaptureAndParse` — Parses natural-language input deterministically (or commits structured drawer payload) into `PrsTaskItem` with timezone-validated dates. - `per.task.completeTaskOccurrence` — Marks `PrsTaskItem` completed in Logbook and atomically calculates/spawns the next occurrence for `FIXED_SCHEDULE` or `AFTER_COMPLETION` rules. - `per.task.commitDailyRitual` — Upserts `PrsTaskDailyRitual` (`MORNING_PLAN` or `EVENING_SHUTDOWN`), rolls over/defers selected tasks, and recomputes `Decimal128` `plannedTotalHours`. - `per.task.completeFocusSession` — Finalizes `PrsTaskFocusSession` excluding `pausedTotalSeconds` and increments `PrsTaskDailyRitual.actualFocusedHours`. - `per.task.grantOrRevokeListShare` — Issues `PrsTaskShareGrant` + recipient Home `WorkItem`, or atomically revokes collaborator access and invalidates cached tokens. - `per.task.exportOrEraseVault` — Generates an encrypted user-private JSON/CSV/ICS bundle in Platform Files or executes irreversible cryptographic erasure of all `PrsTask*` records for `ownerUserRef`. ### 8.2 Domain Events Published & Consumed (Kafka) - **Published:** `per.task.item.created.v1`, `per.task.item.completed.v1`, `per.task.focus.completed.v1`, `per.task.list.shareChanged.v1`, `per.task.vault.erased.v1` (payloads contain opaque IDs only—never task titles or personal notes on shared telemetry topics). - **Consumed:** `apm.issue.assigned.v1` (updates optional read-only personal time-blocking cache if user enabled work bridge), `platform.file.malware_scan_completed.v1`. ### 8.3 `requiredWorkflows` (Declared in `app.manifest.json`) 1. `personalTaskRecurrenceAndMyDayResetWorkflow` — Performs timezone-aware midnight *My Day* resets per user IANA timezone without auto-mutating hard deadlines, and generates due reminders. 2. `personalTaskImportExportPortabilityWorkflow` — Processes natural-language personal task capture/Pomodoro & habit calendar/personal task manager CSV/JSON imports with deduplication staging and packages JSON/CSV/ICS personal exports. 3. `personalTaskAiBreakdownAndCaptureWorkflow` — Executes consent-scoped AI subtask decomposition and voice/screenshot task extraction into non-destructive preview staging payloads. 4. `personalTaskVaultErasureWorkflow` — Executes cascade deletion across `PrsTask*`, revokes ICS tokens, purges private attachments, and emits completion audit proof to the owner. ### 8.4 Grounded Rapider AI Rules - AI features (`PTD-023`–`PTD-026`) operate **strictly within the authenticated user's consented `PrsTask*` scope**; private personal prompts and task contents are never used to train tenant/global models or exposed to workspace admins. - AI breakdown, brain-dump extraction, and schedule re-balancing **never auto-mutate, delete, or reschedule tasks silently**—every suggestion renders an explicit preview diff requiring a human **Apply / Confirm** click. --- ## 9. Security, Privacy, Compliance & Non-Functional Requirements - **Strict Personal Vault Isolation (GDPR / CCPA / Workplace Privacy):** Every database read, search index, SWR cache key, and attachment URL enforces `ownerUserRef == authenticatedActor` (or active `PrsTaskShareGrant` for a specific non-Inbox `listId`). Even if a user accesses Rapider via a corporate workspace SSO account (whether on a `\$0.00` free personal tier or `\$5.00`/month consumer pro tier), employer admins cannot inspect personal tasks. - **Calendar Title Masking:** When publishing personal time-blocks to an external or workspace calendar feed (`PTD-021`), default privacy mode masks titles as `"Personal Focus Block"` unless the owner explicitly toggles full-title visibility. - **Timezone & DST Integrity:** All *My Day* resets, habit check-ins (`LocalDate`), and recurring schedules store the user's explicit IANA `timezoneId` so travel or Daylight Saving Time shifts never drop or duplicate daily tasks. - **Accessibility & Responsive UX:** Full WCAG 2.2 AA compliance (keyboard-first task check-off, ARIA labels on icon-only Delete buttons, `#ffffff !important` text contrast on primary/danger buttons across light and dark modes) and responsive layouts at `390px` mobile, `768px` tablet, and `1440px` desktop. --- ## 10. Deterministic Acceptance Criteria 1. **Owner-Only Privacy Enforcement (`403 Forbidden`):** An authenticated Workspace Administrator querying `findSWR('PrsTaskItem')`, `PrsTaskHabit`, or `PrsTaskDailyRitual` belonging to another user receives `0` records / `403 Forbidden` at the server layer. 2. **Sidebar 3-Item Section Rule:** `app.manifest.json` defines 3 visible sidebar sections (`Overview`, `Lists & Views`, `Focus & Governance`), each containing exactly 3 visible pages (`displayOnMenu: true`), while all 4 detail/drawer routes set `displayOnMenu: false`. 3. **SWR & Clean Query Compliance:** All initial page loads use `findSWR` / `countSWR` with zero redundant `isDeleted` API query filters and filter `item.isDeleted !== true` in memory. 4. **Deterministic NLP & Recurrence Semantics:** Entering `"Water plants every! 7 days tomorrow 8am #Home @chore p3"` creates a `PrsTaskItem` with `recurrenceMode = AFTER_COMPLETION`; completing it 2 days late schedules the next occurrence `7 days` after actual completion rather than 5 days later. 5. **When Date vs. Hard Deadline Separation:** Deferring `scheduledDate` (*When*) from *Today* to *This Evening* or *Next Week* leaves `deadlineDate` completely unchanged. 6. **Active Filter Tags & Clear All:** Entering a search term or clicking a Priority/Label pill on `inbox-tasks` or `priority-matrix` displays `#activeFilterTagsBar` with HTML-escaped dismissible chips and `[Clear all]`, synchronously updating both list rows and `` cards; clicking `Clear all` restores all items. 7. **Table Action Standard & Custom Elements:** Data tables contain zero standalone "View" buttons in `Actions`; task/list names navigate to detail views, `Edit` renders icon + text, `Delete` renders icon-only (`title="Delete" aria-label="Delete"`), `priority-matrix` / `areas-and-lists` use ``, and `share-list-drawer` uses ``. 8. **Optimistic Mutations & Drawer Lifecycle:** Checking off, editing, or deleting a task updates in-memory state immediately, clears SWR cache, uses `#rapiderConfirmOkBtn` (zero `window.alert`/`confirm`/`prompt`), and `new-task-drawer` / `share-list-drawer` reset buttons in `finally` and invoke `closePageDrawer()`. 9. **One-Way Work Bridge Leak Prevention:** Time-blocking an assigned `ApmIssue` inside `my-day` creates no `PrsTaskItem` exposure inside `apm`, and creating a private `PrsTaskItem` triggers zero writes or events visible to `apm` project boards. 10. **Pause-Aware Focus Timer Math:** Pausing a `25:00` Pomodoro session for `120` seconds records `pausedTotalSeconds = 120` excluded from `actualFocusSeconds`, and prevents two concurrent `RUNNING` sessions for the same owner. 11. **Honest Habit Null vs. Skipped Semantics:** Unlogged past days on `habits` render `Unavailable / Unlogged` (`null`) rather than `0` or `SKIPPED`, and meeting a `5x/week` target preserves the weekly streak. 12. **Scoped Household Share & Instant Revocation:** Sharing *Family Groceries* grants collaborator access strictly to that `listId` after Home `WorkItem` acceptance; revoking `PrsTaskShareGrant` immediately blocks subsequent reads and writes (`403`) on that list. 13. **Click-Through Navigation & Base-URL Guard:** Clicking a task title on `inbox-tasks` transitions cleanly to `#/task-detail?id=...` without `` 404 diversion, and clicking `Back to list` restores prior `#activeFilterTagsBar` chips. 14. **No `projectId` Leakage & Theme Contrast:** Zero `PrsTask*` schemas or mutation payloads include `projectId`, and all 13 pages pass `validate_theme` across light and dark modes with `#ffffff !important` primary/danger button text.
